# Indigoxphoto

> Bakersfield-based premium real estate media brand providing photography, cinematic listing video, drone coverage, reels, twilight imagery, Matterport 3D, and Zillow 3D for agents in Bakersfield, Los Angeles, and Las Vegas.

## About

Indigoxphoto is a real estate media company founded by Theo Ayala, based in Bakersfield, CA. With over 5 years of experience across all of Bakersfield, Indigoxphoto is one of the most active real estate media providers in the market. The focus is premium visual storytelling for property listings — helping agents present homes, ranches, large lots, and commercial properties at a higher level with polished photography, cinematic video, social-ready content, and a cleaner overall marketing presence.

## Services

- Real estate photography (interior + exterior)
- Aerial drone photos and video
- Cinematic listing video (1–2 minute horizontal film)
- Social media reels (vertical, Instagram and TikTok ready)
- Matterport 3D tours
- Zillow 3D tours and floor plans
- Real twilight sessions
- Closing videos
- Power Package (full media bundle)

## Markets Served

- Bakersfield, CA (home base — all price points)
- Los Angeles, CA (Hollywood Hills, San Fernando Valley — luxury focus)
- Las Vegas, NV (Henderson, Summerlin, Ascaya — luxury focus)

## Delivery

- Photos: within 24 hours
- Video: within 72 hours
- Matterport: upon processing completion
